title: Wolfia vs AutoRFP.ai for RFPs and security questionnaires
summary: AutoRFP.ai is an RFP-first platform priced by project. Wolfia answers security questionnaires, with a trust center and contract review. How they compare.
body_markdown:
AutoRFP.ai is an RFP-first platform priced by project. Wolfia answers security questionnaires, with a trust center and contract review. How they compare.


AutoRFP.ai is an AI platform for RFPs, security questionnaires and DDQs, priced by project. Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center, and this page compares the two using only what each company publishes.


## What AutoRFP.ai is


AutoRFP.ai describes itself as “the accuracy-first, AI-native, source-grounded platform for RFPs, security questionnaires, and DDQs.” It is used for RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires and DDQs, writes only from content a team has approved, cites its sources and routes anything it cannot support to a person. Its Portal Agent is a browser extension that pulls questions out of procurement, due diligence and security portals and fills approved answers back in. AutoRFP.ai says it is not a standalone trust center portal.


## What Wolfia is


Wolfia is an AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center. It answers security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs from a company’s own documents and past answers, gives every answer a cited source, and leaves an answer empty when no document supports it. It works on Excel, Word and PDF files and exports them in their original format, and a Chrome extension fills answers back into web portals. The[Wolfia facts page](https://wolfia.com/facts) lists the rest, including hosting on Amazon Web Services in the United States and SOC 2 Type II.


## AutoRFP.ai and Wolfia side by side


AutoRFP.ai cells come from AutoRFP.ai’s own pages, read 26 November 2026, and Wolfia cells from Wolfia’s published facts.


AutoRFP.ai Wolfia


Primary use RFPs, RFIs, security questionnaires and DDQs, answered from approved content An AI agent for security questionnaires, contract review and the trust center


Security questionnaires Answers SIG, CAIQ and custom questionnaires from approved policies and evidence; only questions the content cannot support reach the security engineers Answers security questionnaires and DDQs from your own documents and past answers ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


File formats Questionnaires arriving as an Excel workbook, a Word document, a PDF or a portal Excel, Word and PDF, exported back in the original format


Web portals Portal Agent browser extension imports portal questions and fills approved answers back; AutoRFP.ai says it works in 100+ portals, including OneTrust, UpGuard and CyberGRX The Chrome extension extracts the questions from web portals and fills the answers back ([Chrome Extension Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/chrome-extension) )


Trust center AutoRFP.ai says it is not a standalone trust center portal Access requests and online NDA signing, where one signed NDA carries across documents ([Trust Center](https://wolfia.com/products/trust-center) )


RFPs Yes, and an RFP, DDQ, tender or security questionnaire each counts as one project Answers RFPs from the same documents and past answers


Contract review Not stated on AutoRFP.ai’s site AI contract review and obligation tracking, with redlines exported as tracked changes ([Customer Contract Intelligence](https://wolfia.com/products/customer-contract-intelligence) )


Knowledge sources Integrations listed include Highspot, Confluence, SharePoint and Seismic, and Box, Google Drive and OneDrive for file storage Including Google Drive, Confluence, SharePoint, OneDrive, GitHub, GitLab, Glean, Guru, Slab, Mintlify and Letter AI ([Knowledge Base Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/knowledge-base-agent) )


Citations Cites its sources, writing only from content the team has approved Every answer comes with a cited source


Human review “People review and approve answers before anything is submitted.” Your subject matter experts review the drafts and only handle the questions where Wolfia is unsure or found no source ([Questionnaire Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/questionnaire-automation) )


Pricing Scale $899 a month with 24 projects a year and Accelerate $1,299 a month with 50, both paid annually; Enterprise pricing above 50 projects a year Plans start at $500 a month ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


Pricing model Per project rather than per user, with unlimited users and all features on every plan; minimum 12-month term after the first 30 days Every plan covers security questionnaires, contract reviews and the trust center, with unlimited users; pricing scales with volume, not headcount


Hosting region US, EU (Germany) or APAC (Australia), at the customer’s choice Amazon Web Services in the United States ([Wolfia trust center](https://trust.wolfia.com/) )


Certifications ISO 27001:2022 certified and SOC 2 Type II audited SOC 2 Type II, and certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework


Free trial Free 7-day proof of concept on your own content, and a 30-day money-back guarantee after signing A “Get started for free” sign-up on wolfia.com; paid plans are scoped on one short call ([Pricing](https://wolfia.com/pricing) )


## Where Wolfia is ahead


Each point below is backed by the table above or by the page it links.


- Wolfia includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing. AutoRFP.ai says it is not a standalone trust center portal.
- Contract review is part of every Wolfia plan. AutoRFP.ai’s site does not state contract review.
- Wolfia plans start at $500 a month. AutoRFP.ai’s Scale plan is $899 a month, paid annually, for 24 projects a year.


## Which team each fits


AutoRFP.ai fits an RFP-heavy team, such as a proposal or sales team, that answers RFPs, DDQs, tenders and security questionnaires from one approved library, wants a choice of US, EU or APAC hosting, and prefers to pay per project after a free proof of concept.


Wolfia fits a security or compliance team whose workload is inbound security questionnaires, DDQs and RFPs in files and web portals, and that wants a trust center and contract review on the same plan. It also answers security questions in Slack through the[Slack Agent](https://wolfia.com/products/slack-autorespond) , and in Claude and ChatGPT through the[Wolfia connector](https://wolfia.com/blog/connect-wolfia-to-claude-and-chatgpt) .

## FAQ


### Does AutoRFP.ai include a trust center?


No. AutoRFP.ai says it is not a standalone trust center portal and does not publish a public trust portal for a company’s own security documents. Every Wolfia plan includes a trust center with access requests and online NDA signing.


### How does AutoRFP.ai pricing compare with Wolfia?


AutoRFP.ai prices by project. Scale is $899 a month for 24 projects a year and Accelerate is $1,299 a month for 50, both paid annually, with unlimited users. Wolfia plans start at $500 a month with unlimited users, and pricing scales with volume, not headcount.


### Do AutoRFP.ai and Wolfia fill web portals?


Both do. AutoRFP.ai’s Portal Agent is a browser extension that pulls questions out of procurement, due diligence and security portals and fills approved answers back in. Wolfia’s Chrome extension extracts the questions from web portals and fills the answers back into the portal.


### Where are AutoRFP.ai and Wolfia hosted?


AutoRFP.ai offers hosting in the US, the EU (Germany) or APAC (Australia). Wolfia hosts customer data on Amazon Web Services in the United States.
